title: Good daily SPF
text: Gentle sunscreen for daily commute. No irritation.

title: White cast
text: It says no white cast but I can still see a white cast.

title: Not worth it
text: Overhyped and not worth it for the price.

title: Great under makeup
text: Lightweight and good under makeup for work.

title: Pool day
text: Used it at the pool and it was not greasy.

title: Repurchase
text: I would repurchase this SPF gel for daily use.
